about: The versions of every component the controller depends on, as walzen prod runs them, and of every tool the tests take from the flake. flake.nix reads the pins and hashes here, and the tests read the versions to check that each recorded fixture came from these tools. The e2e components under hack/e2e pin these versions again in their pins.json, and a test in internal/testinfra/versions fails when the two disagree. After a bump, change the entry here (and its hashes) and in the e2e pins.json that name it, regenerate the recorded fixtures with make fixtures, and run make check and make envtest.

kubernetes.tests: kube-apiserver, kube-controller-manager and kube-scheduler release binaries from dl.k8s.io, pinned in nix/test-tools.nix

kubernetes-e2e.e2e: the kind node of the Docker Desktop cluster (kubectl context docker-desktop) the e2e suites run against, one patch ahead of prod; nothing in the repo installs it

etcd.prod: Talos v1.14 runs its own etcd; Kubernetes 1.36.3 is built against etcd 3.6.8 (build/dependencies.yaml)
etcd.tests: nixpkgs etcd, the newest 3.6 patch in the locked nixpkgs

cert-manager.e2e: hack/e2e/cert-manager/pins.json, and the requirement in hack/e2e/backup-controller/pins.json

barman.prod: the barman-cloud sidecar of plugin-barman-cloud v0.15.0 (containers/sidecar-requirements.in: barman==3.20.0)
barman.tests: nixpkgs barman with its source moved to the release/3.20.0 tag in nix/test-tools.nix

postgresql.prod: the PostgreSQL inside the postgresql-operand image; barman reads the WAL and base backup layout, which does not change within a major
postgresql.tests: nixpkgs postgresql, only to produce the recorded barman stores; it matches the operand's version today, and a test only requires the same major

postgresql-operand.prod: spec.imageName of every prod CloudNativePG Cluster: environments/prod/cluster/authentik/db/inputs.yaml (postgres_image) and the flux templates' database.yaml (apps/wiki, management/grafana); prod does not run the operator's built-in default
postgresql-operand.e2e: hack/e2e/cnpg/pins.json (postgres), the image of the check Cluster

kueue.e2e: hack/e2e/kueue/pins.json, and the requirement in hack/e2e/backup-controller/pins.json

volsync.tests: the Go module github.com/backube/volsync v0.16.0 in go.mod; the recorders run its mover-restic/entry.sh from the module cache

restic-mover.prod: the restic inside the VolSync v0.16.0 mover image (mover-restic/SOURCE_VERSIONS)
restic-mover.tests: the restic release binary, pinned in nix/test-tools.nix as restic-0.18.1
restic-mover.e2e: hack/e2e/volsync/pins.json (restic), inside the VolSync mover image

restic.prod: the restic an operator runs by hand against the prod repositories

rustfs.tests: the RustFS release binary, pinned in nix/test-tools.nix; there is no x86_64-darwin build

bubblewrap.tests: nixpkgs bubblewrap; it gives a mover run the container's /data, PID 1 and hostname

csi-driver-host-path.e2e: hack/e2e/csi/pins.json (the driver's manifests); prod runs zfs-localpv, which the e2e cluster replaces with the host path driver for claims and snapshots

external-snapshotter.e2e: hack/e2e/csi/pins.json: the snapshot CRDs, the snapshot-controller and the csi-snapshotter sidecar
